title: FLA writer: emit Contents CMediaSound/CMediaBits media-catalog records
description: DONE. Implemented the Contents media catalog (CMediaSound schema-6 for sounds, CMediaBits for bitmaps) in contents-write.ts writeMediaCatalog(), emitted between the CDocumentPage chain and the §8.4 stage block, advancing the §5.2 combined-table index via ClassTable.useClass (post-stage CColorDef/CQTAudioSettings template is position-independent so it stays valid). Record body = [class tag][u8 schema=6][u8 streamNameLen]['Media N' UTF-16LE][BomString displayName][u16 0][empty BomString src-path]. VERIFIED: emitted CMediaBits header+body THROUGH displayName is byte-identical to evaporatingdrip.fla's genuine CMediaBits 'Media 4'/'metal' record (the entire span the importer reads); CMediaSound body matches what registerCMediaSoundObject reads. ROUND-TRIP: a saved sound library item + frame sound now round-trips through tryLoadRealFla with frame.sound.libraryItemId RESOLVED (syncMode/repeatCount/inPoint/outPoint preserved), no 'frame sound id N not found in library' warning. Gates: full ordered build green; @flash/core suite green (344 files, 5531 tests, +3 new in real-fla-write.test.ts); empty-bytematch SKIP (0-byte fixture, task 1207, expected); carchive-validate/contents-structure/writer-spec-bytes NOT regressed; evaporatingdrip re-import unchanged. NOTE: a separate PRE-EXISTING timeline-write bug (task 1205 domain) truncates the Page stream for short layer names (e.g. 'L'); default 'Layer 1' parses fine, so the catalog round-trip is verified with that. Docs: added §8.10 media catalog to docs/21-fla-binary-format.md.
